system.description:
Use this skill just after the target rolls on [Exhaustion Table: Energy or Money]. Reduce the result of that roll by -3.

(Fate 1): If you have reached your Limit for this skill, you may pay this cost to use it again.

A special skill that conserves the physical strength and energy of allies and reduces wear and tear by walking while carrying them on their backs, taking on heavy loads, etc.
